summary: An Anthropic employee announced the launch of Claude Fable 5.1, describing it as built for autonomous multi-step work and improved across coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving.

practices.reason: The post claims the new model improves on coding, knowledge work, and autonomous multi-step tasks, but gives no benchmark or figure to act on directly.
practices.quote: Fable models are built for complex, multi-step work that runs on its own, and Fable 5.1 sets a new standard across coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks.
